description: Five L3 GaWF full-replay smoke tasks after Amarel DSSK quota-accounting repair
notes: Task map: 1M replay seeds 1/3 and 2M replay seeds 1/2/3; L4 excluded.
Submitted with SBATCH_NODELIST=gpuk[007,009-013] so every task tests the DSSK view.
All tasks use one Ada Lovelace GPU, 16 CPUs, 64G memory, AIM3_NUM_WORKERS=12, and AIM3_PIN_MEMORY=1.
All five tasks completed with exit 0 on gpuk012, gpuk017, or gpuk018. DSSK quota guard reported 667.4 GiB headroom for every task.
Each result has global_step=25000, metrics.json, metrics_history.jsonl, and one final model checkpoint; replay directories and recovery checkpoint.pth files were released on success.
